vocals.method: Trained vocal separation with learned voice evidence, local source-energy articulation and periodic pitch tracking

timing.alignment: Separated vocal PCM clock; measured energy edges and estimated pitch; no lyric or word alignment

warnings: Voice evidence is ambiguous; uncertain passages stay with the accompaniment.

diagnostics.limitations: Separation bleed, layered voices, distortion, unvoiced consonants and rapid pitch changes can remain ambiguous. Pitch follows a dominant periodic voice, not every harmony. Articulation markers are not transcribed words.
